name: Проклятие! Новая редакция правил
alt: Новая книга правил упала на старую, подняв тучу пыли и кубики.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky forms, strong silhouette. Centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, not copied card art. Clear plausible anatomy, no unintended extra limbs. Subject: One enormous bright crimson hardback rulebook slams onto a tiny battered blue rulebook on a wooden gaming table, sending two simple white dice and a few blank parchment slips bouncing upward. Both covers are entirely blank except simple geometric gold corner ornaments, pages without writing. Huge weight difference, comic impact puff, no characters, no text or digits on dice, use round pips.
